info: Direction-B tee (ADR-0042 §2.3). Wire your PLC/SparkPlug-assembly node's output into 'CPACK tee'. It POSTs RAW tags to the LOCAL sparkplug-agent (http://localhost:9104/v1/tags); the agent builds SparkPlug B and uplinks over mTLS. Node-RED stays SparkPlug-ignorant. Set env CPACK_INGEST_KEY = the local tee↔agent key (compose.edge.yml wires it from AGENT_INGEST_API_KEY).
label: CPACK ingest tee

name: CPACK tee (build /v1/tags envelope)
